description: An apartment that truly feels like your Parisian home, boasts a bright and airy appeal in a coveted Haussmannien building. Original ceiling & wall moldings, marble fireplaces, 4 bedrooms, 3,5 bathrooms, an eat-in kitchen, your Parisian getaway begins! Steps away from the park, you can enjoy quieter moments surrounded by design furniture spread across two connected living rooms & a majestic dining room. Or savour your morning coffee on the small balcony facing the Eiffel Tower in full-sun.
